meta.title: Chenyu cloud workflows
meta.description: Run ComfyUI workflows from saved Chenyu Pod versions or existing instances. Choose a GPU, track jobs in your session, and download results.

ui.localeError: Could not load Chenyu interface translations.
ui.keyReadOnly: This credential is managed outside these settings.
ui.libraryHelp: Save a cloud Pod UUID to make its image versions available in the workflow panel. Removing it only removes the saved entry.
ui.upToDate: This instance is on the latest available version.
ui.updateCannotApply: A newer version is available. Safe instance creation is unavailable for this instance.
ui.createVersion: Use newer version in a new instance
ui.createHelp: Chenyu will create or reuse an instance for {tag} and keep the current instance. If setup starts a GPU, compute charges may apply.
ui.updateApplied: The new version is ready to select. The previous instance was kept.
ui.configureInSettings: Set the API key in Chenyu Cloud settings to choose a source and GPU.
ui.noSession: Open a conversation to submit or view its jobs.
ui.savePodFirst: Add a Pod to the library in Chenyu Cloud settings.
ui.catalogEmpty: This catalog contains no workflow files.
ui.filenameAlias: Exact workflow filename, MOSS, or H3
ui.scanFee: Reading this catalog may create an instance or start a GPU and incur compute charges. Selected GPU rate: {price}.
ui.promptHint: Leave blank to use the prompt saved in the workflow.
ui.pathsHelp: Use paths relative to this session’s workspace. Enter one reference path per line. Use node inputs for custom workflow parameters.
ui.runFee: The queue starts compute as needed. Selected GPU rate: {price}.
ui.noJobs: This session has no Chenyu jobs yet.
ui.shutdownFailed: Shutdown has yet to be confirmed. The queue will retry. {error}
ui.defaultUnknownGpu: The default GPU is missing from the Chenyu catalog. Select a GPU to proceed.
ui.noGpuCapacity: The selected GPU has no available capacity. Refresh the GPU list or select another GPU.
ui.autoShutdown: The queue automatically shuts down compute it started when its work is done.
